passages.provision_quote: Section 13-3603, Arizona Revised Statutes, is repealed.
passages.note: The operative section is a bare repeal; it enacts no gestational limit and the repealed statute's text is not in the sources.

rows.reasoning: On HB2677 (2024) Stahl Hamilton is prime sponsor ("Stahl Hamilton (Prime)") and voted Y ("STAHL HAMILTON Y", "Passed 32-28-0-0-0"), and the operative section states "Section 13-3603, Arizona Revised Statutes, is repealed." Repealing a criminal statute points away from "ban abortion in all cases, with no exceptions" and from "ban abortion except in cases of rape, incest, or a serious risk to the mother's life", but the bill sets no gestational limit of its own. Nothing here separates "keep abortion legal at every stage of pregnancy, with no time limit." from "keep abortion legal through the second trimester, and after that only to protect the mother's health." or from "allow abortion during the first trimester, and after that only to protect the mother's health."
